# Happy Simple Mom

> A resource hub for simplified living, decluttering, and home organization through courses, community, and membership programs.

Happy Simple Mom provides decluttering courses, organizational resources, and community support for people seeking to simplify their homes and lives. The site offers membership programs, free resources, and structured challenges to help users achieve minimalist lifestyles.

## Key Topics

- decluttering
- minimalism
- home organization
- membership program
- The Big Declutter
- course sales
- free resources
- community
- weekly challenges
- checklist
- pricing tiers
- limited-time offers
- Facebook
- Pinterest
- Instagram
